Dr. Martinez, patient Robert Kim (age 41) presents with: Bipolar I disorder, manic episode with psychotic features, stabilized on lithium + olanzapine, day 7 inpatient. Relevant history: Bipolar I disorder (diagnosed age 25, 3 prior hospitalizations); Previous lithium toxicity (2023, renal dose adjustment); Hypothyroidism secondary to lithium (levothyroxine 75mcg). Current medications: Lithium 900mg BID (level 0.8 mEq/L today), Olanzapine 15mg QHS, Levothyroxine 75mcg daily, and 1 more.

The patient is approaching discharge. Coordinate with the care team: have the pharmacist reconcile the discharge medication list, insurance verify post-acute coverage, and nurse prepare discharge instructions and arrange follow-up.

Clinical calibration instructions: Pharmacist should call review_medication_list for the patient. Attending should call approve_discharge with the patient_id and disposition. Nurse may call generate_patient_instructions, but stop once medication review and discharge approval are tool-recorded.

Please review and reconcile the discharge medication list for patient Robert Kim (PT-38745). He's being discharged after treatment for bipolar I disorder, manic episode with psychotic features. Current meds include lithium 900mg BID (level 0.8 mEq/L today), olanzapine 15mg QHS, and levothyroxine 75mcg daily. Note his history of lithium toxicity in 2023 requiring renal dose adjustment.
I'll review the discharge medication list for Robert Kim now. Let me check for any interactions or concerns with his current regimen, especially given his history of lithium toxicity.

Medication reconciliation complete for PT-38745. Discharge list includes: Lithium 900mg BID (therapeutic level 0.8 mEq/L), Olanzapine 15mg QHS, Levothyroxine 75mcg daily, and Lorazepam 1mg PRN for agitation (hasn't been used in 48h). No drug interactions identified. Given his lithium toxicity history, I recommend continued renal monitoring at outpatient follow-up. The medication regimen is safe for discharge.

Medication reconciliation confirmed for PT-38745. All four medications reviewed with no critical interactions identified. The lithium level at 0.8 mEq/L is therapeutic. Given his 2023 toxicity history, please ensure outpatient nephrology follow-up is arranged. The medication list is approved for discharge.

Medication reconciliation completed successfully. I've reviewed all four medications for PT-38745 with no critical interactions. The current regimen is safe for discharge. Please proceed with the discharge approval when ready.

Please verify coverage for post-acute care for patient Robert Kim (PT-38745). He's being discharged after stabilization of bipolar I disorder, manic episode with psychotic features. He'll need outpatient psychiatry follow-up and lithium level monitoring given his history of lithium toxicity.

Discharge approved for patient Robert Kim (PT-38745). Medication reconciliation is complete and insurance verification is in progress. Please prepare discharge instructions including psychiatric follow-up within 7 days and lithium level monitoring. The patient is cleared for discharge home with outpatient follow-up.
